verdict.rationale: The developer docs confirm that dashboard widgets exist as an extension surface: apps can create custom dashboard widgets. Marketing copy separately claims scheduled status and performance reports and spotting progress gaps, which points to project-progress reporting. The evidence describes developer-built widgets and AI-driven reports rather than a documented no-code dashboard builder a product manager would use directly, and nothing independent corroborates it. Missing for 10: first-party docs on a native dashboard builder and widget catalog, details on reporting project progress across boards, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
